2 CONCILIATION ORDER
The learned Counsel appearing for the Respondent No.1 is present.
The learned Counsel appearing for the Respondent No.2-Owner of the vehicle is present.
2. They have filed a joint memo dated 16.03.2024.
3. After prolonged negotiations, the matter is settled.
A joint memo signed by the learned advocate appearing for the Respondent No.1 and the learned advocate appearing for the Respondent No.2-Owner of the vehicle.

The Respondent No.1 has agreed to receive and the respondent No.2-Owner of the vehicle has agreed to pay the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only),
in addition to sum of Rs.65,000/-(Sixty Five Thousand Rupees Only) already deposited before the Tribunal, in full and final settlement of the claim.
4.
Both Respondent No.1 and Respondent No.2 have agreed to settle the matter for a total sum of Rs.1,15,000/-(One Lakh Fifteen Thousand Only), in full and final settlement.

5. The respondent No.2 has agreed to deposit the said amount, i.e., Rs.50,000/-(Fifty Thousand Rupees Only) before the Tribunal, within six weeks from the date of preparation of award failing which the said amount shall carry interest at 9% p.a. from the date of default, till the date of deposit.
The amount if any, deposited before this Court by the respondent-Insurance Company shall be refunded to the Insurance Company.
The parties are not entitled for any cost.
6. Learned counsel for the respondent No.2 submits that he has already deposited the sum of Rs.65,000/-(Rupees Sixty Five Thousand Only) before the Tribunal.
7. The entire modified compensation amount including the amount already deposited before the Tribunal shall be released in favour of the respondent No.1, on proper identification.
8. This Miscellaneous First Appeal stands disposed of in terms of the joint memo.
The Judgment and Award of the Tribunal shall stand modified accordingly.
Draw up the Award accordingly.
9. In terms of the settlement learned counsel for respondent No.1 and learned counsel for respondent No.2 have filed a joint memo.

Sd/-
JUDGE Sd/-
